definitions.explanation: extremely detailed and careful, showing great attention to accuracy

examples.japanese: {緻密|ちみつ}な{計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てた。
この{絵|え}は{緻密|ちみつ}に{描|えが}かれている。
examples.english: This painting is drawn with meticulous detail.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{緻密|ちみつ}な{性格|せいかく}で{知|し}られている。
examples.english: He is known for his meticulous personality.

notes:
{緻密|ちみつ} describes exceptional attention to detail and precision.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {緻|ち}: Fine, detailed
- {密|みつ}: Dense, close

FORMS:
- Attributive: {緻密|ちみつ}な + noun
- Predicate: {緻密|ちみつ}だ/である
- Adverbial: {緻密|ちみつ}に
- Noun form: {緻密|ちみつ}さ (meticulousness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緻密|ちみつ}な{計画|けいかく} (meticulous plan)
- {緻密|ちみつ}な{分析|ぶんせき} (detailed analysis)
- {緻密|ちみつ}な{作業|さぎょう} (precise work)
- {緻密|ちみつ}な{設計|せっけい} (elaborate design)
- {緻密|ちみつ}に{描|えが}かれた (meticulously drawn)

USAGE:
- Plans and strategies
- Art and craftsmanship
- Academic research and analysis
- Engineering and design
- Personality descriptions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {精密|せいみつ} (precise - more technical)
- {細|こま}かい (detailed - more casual)
- {丁寧|ていねい} (careful - broader meaning)
- {綿密|めんみつ} (thorough - similar meaning)

REGISTER: Formal. Common in academic, technical, and written contexts.
